Subject: Bayside onsite: proposed demo + lab visit (Mar 30)

Hi Lori —

Following up on our call last week. We’re excited to be on-site at Bayside on Tuesday, Mar 30. Suggested agenda: 45–60 minute product demo (runtime + observability), 30-minute lab walkthrough for your infra team, then an open Q&A.

Can you confirm whether morning or afternoon works better for your team? Current plan in my calendar is 10:00–12:00, but we can absolutely shift. If helpful, I can suggest a late-afternoon slot so your group can finish the field event earlier that day.

I’ve attached a draft mutual action plan and the demo agenda for your review.

Thanks —

sofia.ivanova@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0186

Hi Sofia —

Thanks for the agenda and the MAP. Quick note: our field ops team is running a mobile screening event that afternoon and several of the people slated for the lab walkthrough (including our VP of IT) will be off-site until 3:00pm. I’ll be on-site in the morning but will need to step out around 1:00pm to cover post-event logistics.

Would you be able to shift the product demo and lab portion later in the day? Ideally a 3:30–5:00pm block would work best. If that's too late for Redwood, we could also swap the lab walkthrough to Wednesday morning (Mar 31).

Appreciate the flexibility.

—Lori
Lori Chen

lori.chen@baysidehealth.com

- Option A (same day): 15:30–16:15 product demo; 16:15–17:00 lab walkthrough (we compress the lab checklist to the essentials).
- Option B (split): 10:00–11:00 product demo (internal seats only) + recorded deep-dive later; lab walkthrough Wed 08:30–09:30.

I’m looping in Karthik to cover any infra-specific questions during the lab, and Grace from our solutions team to own the technical deep-dive and the recording. If Option A works, I’ll send an updated calendar invite and attach the revised agenda and MAP.

Also attaching an editable calendar invite (.ics) for 15:30 — if you prefer Option B, say the word.
